# RegRely

> RegRely is a privacy and compliance automation platform that helps growing companies
> run their GDPR obligations without a dedicated compliance team — DSAR automation,
> records of processing (ROPA), consent tracking, compliance scanning, risk registers,
> and audit-ready evidence packs.

RegRely is built for startups and growing businesses that need practical compliance
operations rather than enterprise-weight tooling. It is a product of
[Flowmoat](https://flowmoat.com/), an enterprise AI engineering company.

## Regulation coverage

GDPR is supported today. Support for CCPA, HIPAA, and the UAE PDPL is in development. The
underlying workflows — records of processing, data subject requests, consent, risk, and
evidence — are common across all four.

- [GDPR](https://regrely.com/regulations/gdpr/): Supported today. Lawful basis, Article 30 records, data subject rights within one month, 72-hour breach notification, DPIAs.
- [CCPA / CPRA](https://regrely.com/regulations/ccpa/): In development. California disclosure duties, 45-day consumer requests, and the right to opt out of sale or sharing.
- [HIPAA](https://regrely.com/regulations/hipaa/): In development. Business associate agreements, the Privacy and Security Rules, and 60-day breach notification.
- [UAE PDPL](https://regrely.com/regulations/pdpl/): In development. Federal UAE data protection — lawful bases, data subject rights, and cross-border transfers.

## Modules

- [DSAR Automation](https://regrely.com/product/dsar/): Data subject request intake, identity verification, fulfilment workflows, approvals, and evidence-ready responses within statutory deadlines.
- [ROPA Mapping](https://regrely.com/product/ropa/): A live record of processing activities with purpose, legal basis, recipients, retention, and control mapping.
- [Consent Tracking](https://regrely.com/product/consent/): Consent status, policy versions, and revocation workflows across regions and products.
- [Compliance Scan](https://regrely.com/product/compliance-scan/): Control scanning, findings management, and remediation tracking with evidence traceability.
- [Risk Register](https://regrely.com/product/risk-register/): Risk scoring, mitigation ownership, and residual risk acceptance.
- [Reports](https://regrely.com/product/reports/): Executive dashboards and audit-ready exports.

## Industries

RegRely publishes privacy-operations guidance for
[SaaS](https://regrely.com/industries/saas/),
[healthtech](https://regrely.com/industries/healthtech/),
[fintech](https://regrely.com/industries/fintech/),
[ecommerce](https://regrely.com/industries/ecommerce/),
[insurtech](https://regrely.com/industries/insurtech/),
[edtech](https://regrely.com/industries/edtech/),
[logistics](https://regrely.com/industries/logistics/), and
[HR](https://regrely.com/industries/hr/).

## Who RegRely is for

Startups and growing companies — typically without a dedicated privacy team — that hold
customer personal data and face GDPR obligations, enterprise security reviews, or an
upcoming audit.

Read the [small-business GDPR software guide](https://regrely.com/solutions/gdpr-compliance-software-small-business/)
for a practical overview of data mapping, DSAR, risk, consent, remediation, and
evidence requirements.

Tenant isolation, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, and
immutable audit logging. See [security](https://regrely.com/security/).
